text:
Type: upholstered swivel armchair
Use: lounging, reading, conversation; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: textured woven upholstery fabric, wood plinth base
Colors: dark charcoal, warm brown wood trim
Shape: boxy track arms, loose back and seat cushions, upholstered to the floor on a recessed wood plinth, swivel, compact and solid
Feel: cozy, grounded, understated
Goes with: warm wood, cream or white walls, leather, brass; modern or transitional living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Gabrieli Wood-Framed Upholstered Swivel Chair, 29.9"W, Charcoal
product.description: This wood-framed swivel chair is upholstered in a usefully neutral charcoal gray, which makes it easy to work into your existing decor. As a place to work, converse, or relax, this chair is a stylish multitasker. 29.9"W x 33.1"D x 31.9"H Wood frame and foam-filled cushions This swivel chair has an elegant wood base upholstered with a stain-resistant fabric. No assembly required Avoid moisture, and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty
